name: Dependant Permit, Spouse/Child of a Rwandan Citizen (M1)

requirements.blocker_text: Spouse or child (by birth or adoption) of a Rwandan citizen.

sources.title: Directorate General of Immigration and Emigration (DGIE), Rwanda -- M1 dependant of a Rwandan citizen: spouse or child (birth/adoption), 3-year validity, fee 50% of principal applicant's fee; related categories M2 (dependant of a temporary resident, matches principal's validity) and M3 (close relative of a permanent resident, 3yr)

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Rwanda). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- fully tier-1 DGIE sourced. Rwanda distinguishes THREE dependant categories by the sponsor's own status (M1: dependant of a citizen; M2: dependant of a temporary resident, whose validity simply tracks the principal's; M3: close relative of a PERMANENT resident) -- a more finely stratified family-sponsorship structure than most countries in this dataset. This file models M1 specifically (spouse/child of a citizen) as the clearest, most universal case; M2 and M3 are disclosed in the source citation but not separately built as files, a scope decision. work_rights is 'none' -- no work authorization was described for this permit category, consistent with the base student permit's structure (a separate permit is typically needed for work rights in Rwanda's system, see rw_student_permit.json's notes on the same pattern). citizenship_after_months (60) reflects the marriage-based reduced naturalisation timeline for the spouse group specifically (see rw_citizenship_by_marriage.json); the child group's path runs through descent instead.
